title: Block Out Level 7 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 7 is a tall ladder built around one early red side exit. Send the upper-right red block away first, rotate the white ladders through the freed pocket, and let the black mass collapse only after both right-side reds are gone.

landmarks: Block Out Level 7 is a tall ladder built around one early red side exit.
Send the upper-right red block away first, rotate the white ladders through the freed pocket, and let the black mass collapse only after both right-side reds are gone.
The board mixes Red, White, Black and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Use the upper-right red exit first.
The lower-right red block follows the same wall after the white ladders shift.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the upper-right red block out through the red gate on the right wall.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Lift the top white pillar and use the freed right pocket to rotate the lower-right red block upward.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep shuffling the middle white ladders so the lower-right red block can also leave through the same red side gate.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: After both right-side reds are gone, use the extra height to pull the black roof down and let the center white pillars separate.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the remaining white ladders toward the bottom exit as the bottom counter shrinks.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Save the upper-left red block for the late cleanup once the center has flattened.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish by draining the last black column through the bottom lane.

failurePoints: Ignoring the upper-right red side exit and trying to work from the bottom first.
Forcing the upper-left red block too early before the black roof has dropped.
